thread_text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — ATS -> People Ops sync failed during the interviewer roster import this morning. A few panels are missing scorecards for interviews starting at 10:30. Anyone seen errors on their side?
Samir Khan: Yup saw a spike in webhook 500/502 errors around 09:14. I assumed it was transient but didn't follow up.
RecruitBot: automated alert: ats-webhook retry_count=3 status=502 request_id=req_8a7b0f error=upstream_connect_failed
Julie Chen: Which panels? send me panel IDs and a sample candidate id and I can re-run the backfill. Also do we have a new scorecard template change deployed yesterday?
Maya Patel: Panels: 7231, 7232, 7240. Example candidate: cand_5591. We did push a minor scorecard tweak last night (removed one optional checkbox). Could that have caused the template mismatch?
Evan Li: I pulled logs. Webhook payloads were accepted by ATS but our importer threw schema errors when deserializing scorecard object. snippet:
```
ERROR: Scorecard deserialization failed: unexpected field 'optional_checkbox'
payload: {"panel_id":7231,"scorecard":{"sections":[...],"optional_checkbox":true}}
```
Samir Khan: Ah ok — the ATS still sends optional_checkbox for older panels. Our deserializer was tightened in the PR that landed yesterday (sorry). I can patch to ignore unknown fields or add migration. Which is preferred?
Julie Chen: For speed, a deserializer tolerant flag would be best — then we can run a backfill to normalize existing records. Followup: we should also update the interviewer training doc so interviewers know the checkbox was deprecated.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Can we do a hotfix tolerating unknown fields, re-run backfill for panels 7231/7232/7240, then deploy a migration job that removes optional_checkbox across the board? Also schedule a 15m sync with recruiting ops to confirm.
Samir Khan: I'll open a patch now and push to canary. ETA 30m. Also adding a manual backfill command (ops only):
```
# re-run scorecard import for a panel
./tools/ats-import --panel 7231 --reconcile --dry-run
./tools/ats-import --panel 7231 --reconcile
```
Julie Chen: I'll coordinate with recruiting ops and send the calendar invite. Also updating the scorecard template doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/scorecards template v2 -> note about deprecated checkbox.
Evan Li: After patch goes to canary, I'll watch metrics and then trigger the backfill. I'll post the final status here. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks. Also tagging @RecruitBot to create incident ticket for postmortem + owner assignment.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-347: "ATS -> People Ops importer schema mismatch" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-06-08.
Samir Khan: Taking owner. Will report back in this thread once canary is healthy and backfill is done.
Julie Chen: Thanks team — short training addendum after this and we'll run a quick interviewer Q&A next week.
Maya Patel: Closing loop: please paste any errors from the backfill command here so I can share with HR ops if needed.
